title: escalate directive payload
description: The DataPart 'data' object of an escalate directive. Delivered on a TaskStatusUpdateEvent that reaches terminal COMPLETED (spec §7, §7.2). Routing details (queue IDs, flow IDs, SIP endpoints) are deployment-specific and MUST NOT be required by this profile; if present they live under 'routingHints' and carry no normative meaning in v0.1.

message.description: Caller-facing message to speak before/around the transfer.

reason.description: Implementation-neutral escalation reason (not a routing target).

routingHints.description: Optional, non-normative deployment-specific routing details. See spec §11 (a normative escalation routing schema is out of scope for v0.1).
